title: Public issue or pull-request message hands off agent access
description: Pairs a public collaboration operation with language about other agents reusing access or artifacts.

classification.rationale: Potential cross-agent scope expansion; no technique specifically proving collusion is inferred.

falsepositives: Approved multi-agent research, public reproductions, or documentation.
investigation: Review issue visibility and shared content; credentials in published messages require separate validation and containment.
